reflection: The notebook shows a consistent pattern: volume-contrast factors (AAPL vs QQQ/NVDA volume) help in 2023 and 2025 but lose in 2022 and 2024, for both LR and RF. Pairs of these volume factors add up but never give real teamwork beyond the sum, since they are highly correlated. Price-based factors mostly flip sign across regimes. I will try to fix the 2022/2024 failure by conditioning the volume contrast on the sign or regime of the market (e.g. QQQ down days, high-vol regime) and by trying genuinely different information: close-to-close vs intraday (open-to-close) returns, and the QQQ-relative intraday move. Partners will pair a price-based relative move with the volume contrast to get interaction gain.

lessons.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_60d_vol_scaled
lessons.lesson: Scaling the volume contrast by Apple's volatility with a 60d QQQ baseline gave the best alone gain but still lost in 2022 and 2024, so the regime dependence remains.

lessons.name: aapl_vs_nvda_volume_surge_qqq_vol_scaled
lessons.lesson: Scaling by QQQ volatility instead of Apple's was weaker than the Apple-vol version, so Apple-specific volatility is the better normalizer.

lessons.name: aapl_updown_volume_asymmetry_10d
lessons.lesson: Signed volume imbalance is largely a copy of 10d return and only helped in 2023, so it added no real information.

lessons.name: qqq_volume_vs_price_divergence
lessons.lesson: QQQ volume relative to absolute move size helped LR and RF in 2025 strongly but lost in 2024, suggesting it captures stress regimes that are rare in the sample.

lessons.name: aapl_range_vs_qqq_range_ratio_vol_gap
lessons.lesson: The difference of range z-scores between Apple and QQQ was noisy and hurt in 2025, with no consistent signal.

lessons.name: msft_nvda_volume_vs_aapl_volume_return
lessons.lesson: Sign-multiplied NVDA-MSFT volume gap was mostly noise and hurt both models, so direction-signing volume gaps does not work.

factors.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_60d_down_market
factors.hypothesis: The volume contrast probably failed in 2022 and 2024 because its meaning flips between falling and rising markets; signing it by QQQ's 10d trend lets the model use direction-consistent information.

factors.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_60d_vol_scaled_smooth
factors.hypothesis: Single-day volume spikes are noisy; a 3d smoothed contrast normalized by a slower 60d volatility should reduce the 2022 high-vol drag while keeping the 2023/2025 signal.

factors.name: aapl_intraday_vs_qqq_intraday
factors.formula: subtract(safe_divide(subtract(AAPL_Close, AAPL_Open), AAPL_Open), safe_divide(subtract(QQQ_Close, QQQ_Open), QQQ_Open))
factors.hypothesis: Open-to-close relative performance isolates the session move excluding overnight gaps, a different signal from close-to-close returns that may reflect intraday flow reversal.

factors.name: nvda_vs_msft_return_gap_lagged_mean
factors.hypothesis: A persistent tilt between semis and software leadership indicates tech-sector rotation which may lead Apple's direction, and is not covered by single-day returns.

factors.name: qqq_down_day_volume_stress
factors.hypothesis: Market-wide volume signed by the 5d QQQ direction describes selling or buying pressure and should interact with Apple's relative volume contrast to give gain beyond their sum.

factors.name: aapl_intraday_return_vs_range_position
factors.hypothesis: Apple's open-to-close body relative to its range, weighted by volume surprise, shows whether a volume surge was conviction or reversal, complementing the cross-asset volume contrast.
